description: Manages information about contacts, allowing retrieval of individual or lists of contact details.

endpoints.name: GetPostedContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all contacts that have been posted or are available in the system.
example_uses: Get a list of all available contacts.
I need to see all contacts in the database.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to retrieve a comprehensive list of all contacts without specifying a particular one.

endpoints.name: GetPostedContact
endpoints.description: Retrieves the details of a specific contact using their unique identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the contact to retrieve.

example_uses: Can you get me the information for the contact whose ID is 789?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you know the specific ID of a contact and need to fetch its detailed information.
